Author: Noranda
Name: XIV Shinies Sync
Description: Automatically records your collection progress on XIV Shinies (https://xiv-shinies.com). New quest, achievement, mount, and minion unlocks appear on the site within seconds; Triple Triad cards, orchestrion rolls, Occult Crescent progress, and the items the site tracks sync automatically in the background. Fully opt-in: nothing uploads until you finish the short setup, and you choose exactly which collections to send. Use /shinies to get started.
Punchline: Your collections, on xiv-shinies.com, the moment you earn them.
